ns2:course.label: Advertising and Society
ns2:course.description: Provides a critical understanding of advertising's role in modern society. Advertising will be studied as a cultural force and social institution. Its role will be examined in relation to communications, economics, and political and legal systems. No graduate credit. Prerequisite: ADV 300.
ns2:course.sectionRegistrationNotes: Restricted to Agr & Environmental Cmc & Educ or Advertising or Agricultural Communications major(s). Not intended for students with Freshman class standing.
